entities.summary: Matthew Man-Oso Ndagoso is a Nigerian Catholic prelate who has served as the Archbishop of the Archdiocese of Kaduna since 16 November 2007. He was formerly the bishop of Maiduguri from 2003 to 2007. On 24th February 2026, he was elected the president of the Catholic Bishops' Conference of Nigeria.
